disclosure: Public SWE-bench issue statements and selected public baseline source ranges are sent through real SDK tools. No reference patches, host test patches, local secrets, or expected answers are sent. The plugin arm keeps every registered task/constraint unit verbatim in the final model input and may replace the text of a tool result it has already sent in full.

native_summary_contract.retention: last units up to target token budget, kept verbatim
native_summary_contract.pinned: leading user statement always kept verbatim
native_summary_contract.boundary: Responses groups are never split across a call/output pair
native_summary_contract.acceptance: summary accepted only when it shrinks the payload
native_summary_contract.failure_policy: provider error leaves the input untouched
native_summary_contract.accounting: summary requests consume the same global request budget
native_summary_contract.regrowth_rule: an already-summarised payload is not summarised again until it grows 25%

budget_calibration.note: Budgets are declared in provider tokens and converted with a measured ratio.

mechanism.name: selective_retention_v4
mechanism.protected: registered task-statement units, constraint-bearing units, Responses tool groups
mechanism.reduction: exact-duplicate units; already-served tool output text replaced by a note
mechanism.fallback: whole-payload fallback for the model call, counted in task_anchor_restore_failures
mechanism.deterministic: no model, no randomness, no text rewriting
